correctness.rationale: Electrical effective-resistance reduction gives the exact formula for every positive gain and every path leader pair. Strict balancing reduces global position optimization to separation. Thirty-one exact quadratic positive-axis sign certificates eliminate all omitted separations for n=3..10, and the explicit three n=10 difference polynomials yield the stated all-gain phase ties and smallest size. For n=5m, Descartes unique positive derivative root, explicit signs at d=3m and 3m+1, parity nonnegative correction, and four factored positive pairwise differences prove the gain-one and gain-two global optima for all m>=2. Exact rational inverse checks: 656; finite family sanity tests: 118, not used as proof of infinite quantifiers.

value.rationale: Two-leader placement under finite feedback is a motivated stochastic-consensus design problem. The precise first size admitting nonmonotonic optimal separation, every gain threshold and all tied optima, plus a rigorous infinite order family reversing the apparent spread-with-gain trend, offer structural design information not reducible to cheap finite tabulation. The unbounded family removes the concern that the phenomenon is a tiny idiosyncratic exception.
